integrity.method: Exhaustive exact integral Morse-chain computation with checked acyclicity, signed matrices, unit Smith eliminations and an eight-row published control.
integrity.source_material: Only original verifier and concise output are included; no third-party full text.

scientific_limitations: Exact integral homology for the finite nine-row staircase board only; no homotopy-wedge decomposition or generalization to larger boards, and publication priority is uncertain beyond inspected material.
title: Integral torsion-freeness at the ninth Stirling rook complex
